question.text: The differential equation of \(\mathrm{y}=\mathrm{ae}^{\mathrm{bx}}\) (a & \(\mathrm{b}\) are parameters) is

solution.text:
\(\begin{aligned}
& \text { Hints: } y=a \cdot e^{b x} \ldots \ldots \ldots \ldots \text { (i) } \\
& y_1=a b e^{b x} \\
& y_1=b y \ldots \ldots \ldots \ldots \ldots \ldots \ldots \ldots \text { (ii) }  \\
& y_2=b_1 \ldots \ldots \ldots \ldots \ldots \ldots \ldots \ldots \text { (iii) } \\
& \text { Dividing (ii) & (iii) } \frac{y_1}{\mathrm{y}_2}=\frac{\mathrm{y}}{\mathrm{y}_1} \Rightarrow \mathrm{y}_1{ }^2=\mathrm{yy}_2
\end{aligned}\)
